combo.description: Engage on a target by using W R E and then Flashing before the E activates. AA AA, then Q AA AA Q.
Use your ally to help engage with W on them, then E AA AA. Q AA AA, then Q AA AA again.
To infinitely club your opponent E AA AA, Q AA AA, then W AA AA Q and repeat.
For a defensive escape, use W then E R.
Make use of your passive by using W AA AA, Q AA AA and then Q AA AA.
Quickly trade using E AA AA, then Q AA AA.
